title: Act: Add the approval gate before publishing
summary: Branch the success path on Config.AutoPublish
description: Edit runner.go success handling so AutoPublish false stops at AWAITING_APPROVAL with the worktree kept, and true calls Publisher.Publish then completes.
technical_constraints: Depends on Act: Create the runner package having been done

steps.lines: the block after the failure branch that sets StatusCompleted
steps.action: Replace with: if !r.cfg.AutoPublish { e.Status = store.StatusAwaitingApproval; e.UpdatedAt = r.now(); save; return e, nil } (no trees.Remove). Otherwise perr := r.pub.Publish(ctx, dir); if perr != nil set StatusFailed, Error, save, Remove, return e, perr; else set StatusCompleted, save, Remove, return e, nil.
